Question.title: Community Question
Question.description: An Islamic discussion question or topic where community members debate with references.

details.description: Detailed explanation or context of the question.

category.description: Category such as Fiqh, Hadith, Quran, Contemporary, Aqeedah.

authorId.description: UID of the user who posted the question.

authorPhoto.description: Photo URL of the author if available.

Comment.title: Question Comment & Reference
Comment.description: A debate comment, perspective, or Quran/Hadith reference posted on a question. Requires user sign-up.

questionId.description: The ID of the parent question.

references.description: Specific Quranic ayahs, Hadith citations, or classical scholarly references.

UserMonthlySalah.title: User Monthly Salah Tracker
UserMonthlySalah.description: Tracks the 5 daily prayers (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) for a given month for an authenticated user.

totalCompleted.description: Total prayers prayed in the month.

records.description: Serialized JSON of day-to-day prayer statuses.

/questions/{questionId}.description: Collection of community discussion questions and debate topics.

/questions/{questionId}/comments/{commen.description: Subcollection of comments and textual references for a specific question.

/users/{userId}/salahMonthly/{monthKey}.description: Monthly salah tracking records for a specific user.
